newsitem.title: UK: BUPA to buy Goldsborough for 76.7 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: BUPA to buy Goldsborough for 76.7 mln stg.

text.p: Private health provider BUPA and Goldsborough Healthcare Plc said on Friday BUPA's subsidiary, BUPA Finance, is buying Goldsborough for 76.7 million stg in cash.
Goldsborough said in a statement the recommended offer was for 175p in cash for each Goldborough share.
The offer represents a premium of 40 percent to Goldsborough's share price at the close of business on June 5, 1997.

Peter Jacobs, chief executive of BUPA, said, "The acquisition of Goldsborough enhances our strategy of expanding and developing our position as a provider of healthcare services of the highest quality."
